audience: DevOps and network engineers who manage DNS and traffic steering with NS1 Connect

useCases.title: Find DNS records by name across your zones
useCases.text: The AI searches zones and records by name, such as every record with shop in it, and can include the answers. It also opens one zone or record for TTL and answers.

useCases.title: Check DNS query counts and traffic
useCases.text: The AI reads query counts for the account, a zone or one record over 1 hour, 24 hours or 30 days, plus current queries per second.

useCases.title: See which health checks are failing
useCases.text: The AI lists monitoring jobs with type, regions, frequency and current status, and the notifier lists that alerts go to. Credentials are redacted.

useCases.title: Review data sources and feeds used for steering
useCases.text: The AI lists data sources with their status and feeds, and opens one feed. You see what drives traffic steering.

useCases.title: Compare account resource use with limits
useCases.text: The AI reads the account summary with utilization against limits, the records used in this billing cycle, and billable queries between two dates.

useCases.title: Add or change one DNS record
useCases.text: The AI creates one plain record such as A, CNAME, MX or TXT, or updates one record's answers or TTL. These changes affect live DNS.
